stem.text: Which graph could show how the resistance $R$ of a filament lamp varies with the applied potential difference (p.d.) $V$, as $V$ is increased to the normal operating p.d.?

A.alt: Graph of R against V: a straight line rising from a positive value on the R axis.

B.alt: Graph of R against V: a curve starting at the origin, rising steeply and then levelling off.

C.alt: Graph of R against V: a horizontal straight line at a constant positive value of R.

D.alt: Graph of R against V: a curve starting at a high value of R on the axis and falling to a low value.
